title: Blitz Mod
description: Blitz is an alpha-stage industrial progression mod built around packet-sized electricity.
body:
#

⚡ BLITZ ⚡

---

Don't just harness power—discipline it.

Welcome to Blitz, where electricity isn't just a number—it’s a physical force, arriving in disciplined, packet-sized bolts of raw potential. Are you ready to tame the static?

--- > ⚙️ **The Core Philosophy: Danger & Discipline** > > Modern tech mods are too safe. Blitz brings back the **danger**. > > - **Dangerous Raw Power:** Power is volatile. Treat it with respect, or your factory might go... *boom*. > - **Readable Early Game:** Intuitive, physics-based mechanics that smoothly guide you from zero to automation. > - **In-World Engineering:** Skip the wikis. Learn safe engineering practices directly inside the game through intuitive mechanics. --- ## 🔧 Your Industrial Journey: From Spring to Source Evolution is mandatory. Safety is optional (but recommended). | Phase | Description | Key Tech | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **01: Primitive** | Before automation, there was... manual labor. Start with pure mechanical force. | *Hand-cranked Springs* | | **02: Mastery** | Tame the electron. Learn insulation, rubber preparation, and critical **low-voltage safety**. | *Rubber Insulation, Basic Wiring* | | **03: Industrial** | Scale up. Manage massive loads with precision grids, storage, and **fluid logistics**. | *Transformers, Fuses, Tanks, Pipes* | | **04: Automation** | Discipline your output. Create complex, synchronized, and optimized factory lines. | *Factory Lines, Optimized Grids* | --- > 📖 **The Integrated Engineer's Guidebook** > > Every industrial complex needs a manual. Blitz includes a built-in **in-world guidebook** that teaches you safe engineering. It doesn't just show you *what* to build; it teaches you *how* and *why* it works safely. No external reading required. --- ## 🌍 Localisation Blitz is natively translated and fully supports the following languages: - 🇺🇸 **English:** 100% - 🇹🇷 **Turkish (Türkçe):** 100% --- > ⚠️ **Current Development State** > > Blitz is currently in **active Alpha development**. > While the early game is functional and readable, **you will encounter bugs**. Features are subject to change. Your feedback is crucial!
